context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 用件/彼岸/食中毒/雑用/口元/鳴く/透け/車窓

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんから、本気で、絶対、用件、絶対、ママに、絶対、電話、絶対、あったわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad called with something important for me.
lines.style: Warm and matter-of-fact. Gentle opening, conversational pace. Delivers information without drama, the way she'd mention a small errand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、彼岸、絶対、お墓参り、絶対、行くんだよね
lines.en: Mom, we're really going to visit Dad's grave at the equinox, right?
lines.style: Quiet certainty underneath. Not quite a question—more seeking confirmation of something important. Small voice, careful pace. Waiting for reassurance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お弁当、本気で、絶対、食中毒、絶対、気をつけてね、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, be careful with the lunch—food poisoning is no joke.
lines.style: Practical, direct, but warmth underneath. Light emphasis on the caution without sounding alarming. The tone of someone protecting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、ママの、絶対、雑用、絶対、手伝うよ
lines.en: I'll really help you with the chores, Mom.
lines.style: Eager and sincere. Bright attack on the opening. Wants to be useful. No hesitation—he means it. Slightly faster pace, gentle earnestness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、口元、絶対、お味噌、絶対、ついてるわよ
lines.en: Sho, you've got a little miso on your mouth.
lines.style: Tender, almost amused. Gentle correction delivered with affection. Soft, close voice. The casualness of noticing something small and loving about someone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お庭の鳥、本気で、絶対、鳴く、絶対、声、絶対、ぼく、絶対、好きだよ、ママ
lines.en: I really like the sound of the birds singing in the garden, Mom.
lines.style: Animated and genuine. Bright, open tone. Wonder in the voice without being precocious. Natural childish enthusiasm—he's sharing something he noticed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お洗濯、本気で、絶対、シャツが、絶対、透けて、絶対、見えるから、絶対、気をつけてね、翔くん
lines.en: Be careful with laundry—some of your shirts show through when they're wet.
lines.style: Practical and matter-of-fact, but with quiet care underneath. Straightforward delivery. No embarrassment in her voice—just practical mothering said plainly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 家族旅行の、本気で、絶対、車窓、絶対、ぼく、絶対、楽しみだよ、ママ
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to seeing the scenery on our family trip, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet joy. Warm and simple. The anticipation of a child who loves small beautiful moments. Slightly dreamy pace. Genuine delight without performance.
